images.title: Upon thorough inspection, all components of the heating and air system were found to be in excellent condition. The thermostat was responsive, and the air filters were clean, ensuring optimal performance. The ductwork showed no signs of leaks or obstructions, and the condenser unit was free of debris. The blower motor operated smoothly, and refrigerant levels were within the ideal range. Overall, the system was functioning efficiently, providing comfort and reliability to the customer.
